name: Humane Society of Forsyth County - Affordable Pet Wellness Clinic
services: Wellness exams, vaccines, microchips, heartworm tests and treatment, spay/neuter
cost_note: Wellness exam $35, DHPP $25, 1-year rabies $30, microchip $30 (current price list)
notes: Clinic hours Thursday through Saturday mornings; no proof of income needed.

name: Humane Society of Forsyth County - Spay & Neuter Surgeries
cost_note: Dog spay $260, dog neuter $220 (current price list, subject to change)
notes: Surgeries by appointment Tuesday through Thursday.

name: Humane Society of Forsyth County - SNAP Spay/Neuter Assistance
services: Spay/neuter surgery at a reduced cost
eligibility: Forsyth County residents who receive government assistance; proof of rabies vaccination required
notes: Bring the completed application to the shelter Tuesday through Saturday, noon to 4 p.m.

name: Humane Society of Forsyth County - Pet Food Pantry
services: Pet food once every 30 days for up to four pets
eligibility: Forsyth County residents facing financial hardship who receive government assistance; pets must be rabies-vaccinated and spayed/neutered
notes: The shelter can help arrange a low-cost spay/neuter if your pet isn't fixed yet.

name: Humane Society of Northeast Georgia - Healthy Pet Clinic
services: Annual vaccines, heartworm testing, discounted prevention, spay/neuter
notes: Basic wellness care, not a full-service clinic; book online.

name: Hall County Animal Shelter - Rabies & Microchip Services
cost_note: Rabies $10, microchip $20, both for $25 (shelter fee list)
notes: Call ahead to confirm when shots are offered.

name: Dawson County Humane Society - Free Spay/Neuter Program
eligibility: Dawson County residents who are DFCS clients or active military families; other low-income residents can call to ask
notes: Call and ask for the free spay/neuter program to book.

name: Furkids Vaccination & Microchip Clinic
services: Rabies, DHPP, bordetella, flu, heartworm tests, microchips, nail trims
cost_note: Rabies $15 (1-year); DHPP free; microchip $25 (current clinic list)
notes: Held monthly at Furkids headquarters; reserve a spot online.

name: Gwinnett County Steve and Julie Helman Pet Vaccine Clinics
services: Rabies, DHPP and bordetella for dogs; FVRCP and rabies for cats; microchips
eligibility: Gwinnett residents only; up to three pets per household
notes: Preregistration required; more clinics planned at county locations in 2027.

name: Atlanta Humane Society - Roswell Vaccine Clinic
services: DA2PP, rabies, bordetella, leptospirosis, microchips, dewormer, flea/tick prevention
cost_note: DA2PP $25, rabies $20, lepto $25, microchip $20 (current clinic list)
notes: Thursday afternoons; book up to two weeks ahead, walk-ins may wait.

name: Atlanta Humane Society - Low-Cost Spay/Neuter
services: Spay/neuter with vaccines and microchip included
cost_note: Dogs from $225 by weight (current AHS price list)
eligibility: Some pets excluded, such as pets 7 or older and certain flat-faced breeds
notes: By appointment, up to four weeks ahead; surgeries are done at the Atlanta location.

name: Society of Humane Friends of Georgia - Spay/Neuter Clinic
notes: Open to the public most Tuesdays and Thursdays by appointment; prepayment required.

name: Spay Neuter Vets
services: Spay/neuter packages, vaccines and microchips at surgery, cat TNR
cost_note: Dog packages from $275 (up to 25 lbs); cat package $175 (current price list)
eligibility: Dogs over 3 months need proof of rabies vaccination
notes: Surgery-focused clinic open weekdays; pain medicine and e-collar included in packages.

name: Georgia Dog & Cat Sterilization Program (Georgia Dept. of Agriculture)
services: State grants that fund spay/neuter through local shelters and rescues
eligibility: Owners apply to the grant recipients, not the state
notes: Check the posted grant recipient lists to find a funded group near you.

name: Healthy Canines, Inc.
services: Grants toward vet costs for illness, injury, medication or medical equipment for dogs
eligibility: Georgia dog owners who meet grant guidelines; focus on low-income families
notes: Apply online through the grant application page.

name: PALS Atlanta (Pets Are Loving Support)
address: 1530 DeKalb Avenue NE, Suite A, Atlanta, GA 30307
services: Pet food, basic care, vaccination clinics
eligibility: Atlanta-area seniors 65+, people with critical illness or disabilities, and veterans
